summary: The PR resolves the issue of allowing non-disjoint cycles in the Permutation constructor by modifying the error handling logic. However, it may introduce behavioral changes that need further consideration.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the Permutation constructor when non-disjoint cycles are provided. While the current implementation raises an error, the proposed change will allow such input and compute the resulting permutation. This could lead to unexpected behavior for users who rely on the current error-raising mechanism.
